compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: Israel offers sacrifices at Beersheba, receives a night vision, and hears God promise presence in Egypt and a future return.
observations.label: Israel sacrifices before going to Egypt

observations.body: The passage presents sacrifice, night speech, descent to Egypt, presence, and return as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: sacrifice, night speech, descent to Egypt, presence, and return

observations.body: The passage places journey and assurance beside sacrifice, night speech, descent to Egypt, presence, and return.
observations.label: journey and assurance

payload.posture: Read Genesis 46:1–7 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the source does not say the sacrifice caused the promise
payload.title: Israel sacrifices before going to Egypt
